name: Hotel Sitara Residency

address.streetName: Riddhi Arcade, Plot No. 857, C & D Sector KWC, Near Bima Complex

businessDescription: Hotel Sitara Residency offers a comfortable and pleasant stay with modern facilities and friendly service. Guests can enjoy free Wi-Fi, making it easy to stay connected during their visit. The hotel also provides free parking, airport transportation, car hire, and shuttle services for convenient travel around Mumbai. The helpful front desk team offers concierge assistance and luggage storage. Guests can relax with room service and daily housekeeping, while laundry and dry-cleaning services keep clothes fresh. The hotel is non-smoking, with designated smoking areas available. Rooms are designed for a comfortable stay and may include a television, bottled water, coffee or tea maker, towels, toiletries, and quality linen. With convenient services and a welcoming atmosphere, Hotel Sitara Residency is a great choice for both business and leisure travellers visiting Mumbai.
